feeds.title: Scroll Saw Woodworking & Crafts
feeds.description: The Scroll Saw Woodworking & Crafts blog has everything for the scroll saw enthusiast, from tips and techniques and tool reviews to patterns and instructions for amazing projects including fretwork, intarsia, portraits, puzzles, and more. Scroll Saw Woodworking & Crafts magazine is published quarterly for both subscribers and newsstand readers.

feeds.title: Scrollsaw Workshop
feeds.description: Find free scroll saw patterns, video demonstrations, scroll saw links, reviews, and much more at The Scrollsaw Workshop Blog by Steve Good. His blog offers pattern catalogs for Woodcraft arts, recommendations for saw blades, and other fine craft products.

feeds.title: Free Saw Patterns
feeds.description: Explore free craft wood patterns at Free Saw Patterns for all your crafting needs. Execute beautiful patterns, ideas, puzzles, and other pieces of art with the help of our blog.

feeds.title: DM Idea
feeds.description: The DM Idea blog shares Scroll Saw Patterns / Woodworking Plans, and tutorials on how to make exquisite models of objects like Mountain bikes, Trucks, Spaceships, and more. Explore a wide range of Categories from Gifts and Decorations, Wooden Toys for Children, and Functional gadgets among other cool stuff.

feeds.title: ScrollSawNewb
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Chris, and I began woodworking a little over a year ago, in 2011. I'm making an attempt with this guide to introduce novice scroll saw users to the tool's universe and to provide hints and suggestions.
